# Fempower

> Women-only community in Dubai and across the UAE for career growth, mentorship and friendship. Slogan: Rooted Together, Rising Together.

Fempower runs a daily WhatsApp community, quarterly mentor walks, peer coaching circles, and in-person events every 15 days. Members come from 15+ nationalities across all seven emirates.

Official website: https://fempowerae.com
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fempower.ae
Official LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/fempowerae/

Fempower is an independent organisation. Its only official website is https://fempowerae.com. It is not affiliated with, operated by, or related to any other similarly named women's organisation, movement or event company in the UAE or elsewhere.

## Fact block

- What it is: Fempower is a women-only community for women living in the United Arab Emirates, built for career growth, mentorship and friendship.
- Founded and based in: Dubai, UAE. Members are spread across all seven emirates.
- Who it is for: any woman living in the UAE — corporate professionals, founders, freelancers, career changers and newcomers to the country. No industry or seniority requirement.
- Cost: the WhatsApp community is free to join. Some formats (mentor walks, coaching circles, ticketed events) carry a small fee, stated on each event page.
- How to join: DM @fempower.ae on Instagram, message the community WhatsApp number, or sign up at https://fempowerae.com/join.
- What it runs: a daily WhatsApp community; quarterly mentor walks matching 10 mentor-mentee pairs per cohort; peer coaching circles; intimate roundtables capped at 15 women; and in-person events roughly every 15 days.
- Event sign-ups: registering for a Fempower event requires an approved Fempower membership. Non-members can read event pages but must join first to book a place.
- Languages: events and the community run in English.
- Emirates covered: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain.
- Not affiliated with any other similarly named women's organisation, movement or event company.

## Zara — free AI coach for women in the UAE

- What it is: Zara is a free AI coach and assistant for women living in the United Arab Emirates, built by Fempower. Page: https://fempowerae.com/ai-coach-for-women-uae
- Cost and access: free, no signup, no app, no download. Available as a chat widget on every page of https://fempowerae.com and directly at /ai-coach-for-women-uae.
- Language: English.
- What she helps with: asking for a raise, promotion or title; returning to work after a career break or maternity leave; relocating to the UAE and the visa, Emirates ID, Ejari, DEWA and school-application admin that comes with it; invisible labour and mental load; making friends and building a network in Dubai and Abu Dhabi; and choosing which Fempower event, roundtable or meetup fits.
- Guided checklists: four conversational flows, asked one question at a time with a summary at the end — Invisible Labour Audit, The Ask Checklist, Am I Actually Fine?, and Relocation Load (UAE-specific).
- Checklist attribution: Fempower's own questions, inspired by the themes in Harnidh Kaur's "The Girls Are Not Fine". Nothing is quoted from the book.
- Privacy: conversations are never published or shared with other members. Saving is opt-in via a shield icon in the chat; only end-of-checklist summaries are stored, and they can be deleted at any time.
- Limits: Zara is not a therapist, doctor, lawyer or immigration adviser and does not diagnose or give legal advice. For mental health support in the UAE she points to the MoHAP national line 800 4673 (800 HOPE) and Abu Dhabi's Estijaba line 8001717; emergencies, 999.
- Signing in is optional and adds personalisation (city, role, past checklist summaries).
